task: Epic 12 (Subsidiary Management Plan Standards and Content Contracts - Stories 12.1 to 12.4): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: AC_0 to AC_7 across the four stories are contract-testable: the canonical frontmatter parses to known values, each grammar rule has passing and failing cases, every malformed construct gives a Tier B finding with line and content, a measured word count returns a known number, floors and caps have boundary cases, and next_step is checked over the full tier by generator by retries matrix. Story 12.2 AC_5 now states how the test extracts the ADR example.

Each criterion traces to an FDD-012 section, a BRU-012 rule and an ADR-012 section, and each rule sits in one story's criteria (LL-012): grammar in 12.1, metadata in 12.2, content in 12.3, precedence in 12.4.

Four stories of one pure package. Story 12.3 is the broadest (word count, headings, floors, caps, boundary, omission flags, lint_plan); omission_flags and lint_plan could move to their own story. Out of Scope excludes Tier A detection, hashing, the DAG, orchestration and per-plan rules.
